title: Security Deposits Tier Schedule by Rate Schedule and Assessment Basis
content:
Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative secures its service accounts through six Security Deposits tiers. Each tier is open only to service accounts on the rate schedules it names, and it is used only for the assessment bases it lists.

## Schedule of tiers

| Security Deposits tier | Rate schedules of the accounts assessed on it | Assessment bases for which the tier is used |
|---|---|---|
| Residential Standard Deposit | Schedule R Residential Service | new service; usage reassessment; waiver reinstatement |
| Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection |
| Seasonal Residence Deposit | Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | new service; reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection; waiver reinstatement |
| Farm Service Deposit | Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | new service; usage reassessment; waiver reinstatement |
| General Service Deposit | Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service | new service; reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection; usage reassessment; waiver reinstatement |
| Irrigation and Large Power Deposit | Schedule IR Irrigation Service; Schedule LP Large Power Service | new service; reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection; usage reassessment; waiver reinstatement |

## Reading the schedule

- The rate schedule column is the entry gate of the tier: a tier is never used for an account on a schedule it does not name.
- The basis column limits the tier further: a tier is used only for the bases listed on its row.
- Schedule R and Schedule FH each appear on two rows. On those schedules the Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit is the tier for a reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection, while the Residential Standard Deposit (Schedule R) and the Farm Service Deposit (Schedule FH) carry new service, usage reassessment and waiver reinstatement.

## Illustrations (hypothetical accounts)

| Hypothetical account | Basis | Row that fits |
|---|---|---|
| A Schedule GS-3 grain bin site | new service | General Service Deposit |
| A Schedule FH farm home | reconnection after a nonpayment disconnection | Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit |
| A Schedule RS lake cabin | waiver reinstatement | Seasonal Residence Deposit |
| A Schedule R household | usage reassessment | Residential Standard Deposit lists the basis; whether an additional deposit is ever assessed on it is governed by that tier's reassessment terms |
